## Problem and result

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List checks and observed results. Separate source, build, simulator, and device
evidence. State what was not tested. Do not include private logs or identifiers.

## Risks and recovery

Describe effects on saves, prefixes, runtime behavior, input, and dependencies
where relevant. State how to recover or revert. Use "None identified" only when
reviewed; explain unresolved risks.

## Release impact

State user-visible changes, breaking changes, and required migration. Identify
license/source-record changes, or state that no dependencies changed.
